title: Prepare Iris features for projection
description: You load the feature matrix and compute a two-component view.

steps.description: You load Iris features, target labels, and their names. X holds floating-point measurements, while y holds the class labels.
You print the dataset shape and standardize X. The recording reports 150 rows, four features, and three named species.

steps.question: Does the principal-component call use the raw features or standardized features?
steps.answer: It receives X_std and requests two components. Z stores the projected observations.

steps.description: You print the explained variance ratios, the fractions of variance associated with those components. The recorded values are 0.7296 and 0.2285.
